page.overview:
Who is Belladonna?

Belladonna is a member of the Black Caps, the City Watch of the mercantile city-state of Marienburg.

Belladonna was the first female member in the history of the organization. A few have followed in her footsteps, but the collective term for Black Caps would probably always be watchmen, regardless of their gender.

Recently Belladonna suffered tremendous wounds during her watch. She was discovered in an underground temple but the healers and apothecaries of the Marienbug Watch have done wonders with her.
